semiconductor_relevance: High — Capcon Limited specializes in advanced packaging equipment for the semiconductor industry, providing critical solutions for die bonding and encapsulation processes.
summary: Capcon Limited is a high-end equipment manufacturer focused on advanced packaging technology for the semiconductor industry. They offer a comprehensive range of die bonding equipment and solutions tailored to meet the needs of leading OSAT and IDM clients.
